messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired for service=latency.p99 — us-west region exceeded 1.2s for 5m. Incident id pd_incident_789. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/latency?orgId=1

alex (oncall): ack. I'm taking this. Starting runbook checks (kv-cache, sidecars, autoscaler).

ji (sre): looking at infra — huge spike in kv cache evictions on us-west sidecars + model-sidecar CPU climb. suspect hotkey amplification. Pulling evictions graphs.

alex (oncall): running quick mitigation: `redwoodctl traffic reroute --from us-west --to us-west-dedicated --percent 20` to shift noisy traffic, and scaling dedicated pool +2 GPUs.

pagerduty: PD note — Incident acknowledged by alex (oncall). Escalation timer set: 15m.

liz (eng): adding a short-term per-client rate-limit to blunt the hotkey blast: patch ready `api.rate_limit.client: 100rps` will deploy to canary.

kate (cs): CS: we've seen two support threads mentioning slow responses / timeouts in the last 10m from enterprise accounts in us-west. I'll prepare a short status page blurb once we confirm initial mitigation impact.

omar (pm): please confirm which endpoints are affected (chat vs embeddings vs rerank). customers want ETA and scope.

ji (sre): quick telemetry: p95 dropped from ~900ms to ~350ms after reroute started; p99 still ~1100ms and noisy. KV evictions dropped 35% but tail persists. Sidecar memory pressure reduced after scale.

alex (oncall): canary rate-limit deployed to 3 pods. Observing. If p99 doesn't fall below 800ms in 5m, escalate to SRE lead. Logs: `s3://redwood-logs/latency/pd_incident_789/`

incident-bot: Autoscaler triggered for us-west-dedicated: +1 node (total dedicated capacity +40%).

kate (cs): publishing: "We are investigating increased API latency affecting some customers in us-west. Mitigations are in progress; we will update in 15 minutes." Posting to status.redwood.com now.

alex (oncall): leaving short handoff notes: reroute=20% to dedicated, canary rate-limit in place, autoscale +1 node, key metrics in grafana panel /d/abcd/latency. If it regresses, disable reroute and revert rate-limit then collect flame traces. Handing off monitoring to @ryan in ~7m.

ryan (oncall): ack — I'll pick this up for the next window, monitoring dashboards and PD thread. :eyes:

ji (sre): recommended next steps if p99 stays high: 1) run shard-level hotkey sampling, 2) increase cache size for hotkeys in us-west, 3) consider temporary weighted-sampling fallback to smaller model.

alex (oncall): noted. If we don't get p99 under 800ms within the escalation timer, I'll trigger step 2 and call for a short bridge.

kate (cs): ping me if we need a customer-facing update beyond the current message. I can escalate to account owners. :+1:

incident-bot: update logged — state=acknowledged, assignee=alex (oncall), incident=pd_incident_789.
